WorkTypeDef.description: Check guests in and out, show them around, keep them entertained and talk them into staying (or joining).
Staff counters, tables and tills: take orders, serve food and drinks, run the casino floor, restock shelves.

DesignationCategoryDef.label: Hospitality
DesignationCategoryDef.description: Signs, counters, shelves, tables and machines for guests: taverns, shops, casinos, spas, cinemas and the back room.

DesignatorDropdownGroupDef.label: casino
DesignatorDropdownGroupDef.description: Slot machines, gaming tables and the cashier's cage.

DesignatorDropdownGroupDef.label: wellness
DesignatorDropdownGroupDef.description: Saunas, hot tubs and massage tables.

DesignatorDropdownGroupDef.label: city life
DesignatorDropdownGroupDef.description: Cinema screens, salon chairs, park benches and the taxi stand.

DesignatorDropdownGroupDef.label: back room
DesignatorDropdownGroupDef.description: Doors, pits, counters and docks for the things nobody talks about. Shown while the Underworld module is on and the content intensity is not Cozy.
